text:
You've got the first part right! An object in motion does stay in motion.

But your second sentence, "Force makes things keep moving," is a common mix-up. A force isn't needed to *keep* an object moving; a force is what *changes* its motion (like slowing it down or speeding it up).

Imagine you slide a book across a very slippery, icy surface. What happens to the book's motion after it leaves your hand?

updates.reason: Identified misconception about force maintaining motion.
